reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the $29.99 for 30 sachets and the pocket-size sachets, which are cute for my tote bag. But I paid about half of that for a bottle that lasts 3 months, so one month for $29.99 is way too much on my budget.
objection: $29.99 is a month of magnesium. My bottle from a flash sale cost less and lasts 3 months, so I'd be paying double or more just for the sachet packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A first-box deal around $14 to $15, or a bigger box (60+ sachets) at about the same price per day as my bottle.
